title: 🐯 Indian Animals & Present Simple (факты о животных)
description: Учим названия животных Индии, части тела животных, прилагательные и Present Simple для описания фактов. Мемы, факты и хаски-блогеры! 🐾

days.title: Day 1: Animals of India
days.description: Знакомимся с животными Индии — тиграми, слонами, кобрами и носорогами

grammar.title: Present Simple (утверждение) для фактов
grammar.rule:
📘 **Present Simple** используется для фактов и постоянных ситуаций.

📝 **Формула**:
✅ I/You/We/They + глагол
✅ He/She/It + глагол + **-s**

🎯 **Примеры**:
✅ The Bengal tiger lives in India.
✅ Elephants eat plants.
✅ A cobra has got a hood.

🚫 **Важно**: Для he/she/it добавляем -s к глаголу!
✅ It lives. ❌ It live.

vocabulary.example: The Bengal tiger is the national animal of India.
The Indian cobra is a very dangerous snake.
Indian elephants have got small ears.
The Indian rhino has got only one horn.
vocabulary.context_example: У индийского носорога только один рог.

vocabulary.example: Tigers hunt deer in the forest.
vocabulary.context_example: Тигры охотятся на оленей в лесу.

vocabulary.example: Snakes live in the grass.
The Bengal tiger has got black stripes.
Elephants use their trunks to eat and drink.
vocabulary.context_example: Слоны используют хобот, чтобы есть и пить.

exercises.question: Which animal is the national animal of India? 🇮🇳
exercises.explanation: The Bengal tiger is the national animal of India! 🐯

exercises.question: The Indian cobra ___ (live) in India. 🐍
exercises.explanation: Cobra — он (it), поэтому добавляем -s: lives! 🐍

exercises.question: Indian elephants have got big ears.
exercises.explanation: Indian elephants have got SMALL ears. African elephants have big ears! 🐘

exercises.question: A rhino ___ (have) one horn. 🦏
exercises.explanation: Rhino — он (it), поэтому has (не have)! У индийского носорога один рог 🦏

exercises.question: Tigers hunt deer. They eat meat.
exercises.explanation: Всё верно! Тигры охотятся на оленей и едят мясо. Это факт! 🐯🦌

days.title: Day 2: Parts of the Body
days.description: Учим части тела животных и описываем их

grammar.title: Present Simple — описания
grammar.rule:
📘 **Как описать животное**:
✅ It has got + часть тела
✅ It is + цвет/размер
✅ It lives + место
✅ It eats + еда

🎯 **Примеры**:
✅ The tiger has got orange fur with black stripes.
✅ It lives in the jungle.
✅ It eats deer.

vocabulary.example: Tigers have got sharp teeth.
Birds have got wings, but snakes haven't.
vocabulary.context_example: У птиц есть крылья, а у змей нет.

vocabulary.example: Cats have got soft paws.
Peacocks have got colourful feathers.
Giraffes have got very long necks.
Elephants have got long tusks.

exercises.question: What does an elephant use to eat and drink? 🐘
exercises.explanation: Elephants use their trunk to eat and drink! 🐘

exercises.question: A peacock has got colourful ___ . 🦚
exercises.explanation: Peacock — павлин. У него красивые разноцветные перья! 🦚

exercises.question: Snakes have got wings.
exercises.explanation: Snakes haven't got wings! У змей нет крыльев 🐍

exercises.question: Tigers have got sharp ___ . (teeth / paws)
exercises.explanation: Tigers have got sharp teeth for hunting! 🐯🦷

exercises.question: Giraffes have got short necks.
exercises.explanation: Giraffes have got LONG necks, not short! 🦒

grammar.title: Adjectives for Animals
grammar.rule:
📘 **Прилагательные для описания животных**:

📏 **Размер**: big, small, tall, short, long
🎨 **Цвет**: orange, black, brown, white, yellow, grey
📊 **Особенности**: dangerous, beautiful, heavy, funny, strong, fast, slow, cute

🎯 **Структура**:
✅ The Bengal tiger is beautiful.
✅ The elephant is very heavy.
✅ The cobra is dangerous!

vocabulary.example: Cobras are very dangerous snakes.
Elephants are very heavy animals.
The Bengal tiger is a beautiful animal.
The Indian rhino looks funny with its one horn.
vocabulary.context_example: Индийский носорог выглядит забавно со своим одним рогом.

vocabulary.example: Cobras can move very fast!
Elephants are very strong animals.

exercises.question: Which word describes something that can hurt you? ⚠️
exercises.explanation: Dangerous — опасный. Кобра может быть опасной! 🐍

exercises.question: The elephant is very ___ . (heavy / light)
exercises.explanation: Слон очень тяжёлый! 🐘

exercises.question: A cobra is a beautiful animal.
exercises.explanation: Cobras can be beautiful — they have interesting patterns! 🐍

exercises.question: The Indian rhino looks ___ with its one horn. (funny / heavy)
exercises.explanation: Носорог выглядит забавно с одним рогом! 😄🦏

exercises.question: What is the opposite of 'slow'? 🏃
exercises.explanation: Fast — быстрый, противоположность slow 🏃

days.title: Day 4: Reading — Amazing Creatures of India
days.description: Читаем текст о животных Индии и учимся находить факты

grammar.title: Чтение и понимание текста
grammar.rule:
📚 **Стратегия чтения**:
1️⃣ Прочитай текст целиком, чтобы понять общий смысл.
2️⃣ Найди ключевые слова (названия животных, цвета, размеры).
3️⃣ Прочитай вопросы и найди ответы в тексте.

💡 **Совет**: Обрати внимание на глаголы в Present Simple!

exercises.question: How many Indian rhinos are there today? 🦏
exercises.explanation: There are only about 2,000 Indian rhinos today. They are endangered! 🦏
exercises.readingText:
🌟 AMAZING CREATURES OF INDIA 🌟

India has got some of the most amazing animals in the world! Let's learn about them.

🐯 BENGAL TIGER

The Bengal tiger is the national animal of India. It has got orange fur with black, grey or brown stripes. Tigers hide in tall grass and hunt big animals like deer. They are really beautiful!

🐍 INDIAN COBRA

The Indian cobra is a black, brown, white or yellow snake. It is very dangerous and can bite. Cobras can move very fast!

🐘 INDIAN ELEPHANT

Indian elephants are very big and tall (2-3 metres), but they have got small ears. Usually a big female is the leader of a family of elephants. Indian people use elephants to carry heavy things with their trunks.

🦏 INDIAN RHINO

The Indian rhino is a funny animal! It only has got one horn (African rhinos have got two). It usually lives alone and likes to sit in water or mud. There are only about 2,000 Indian rhinos today. We must protect them!

🌿 WHAT DO YOU THINK?

Which animal is your favourite? Comment below! 👇

exercises.question: What colour is the Indian cobra? 🐍
exercises.explanation: The Indian cobra is black, brown, white or yellow! 🐍

exercises.question: Indian elephants have got big ears.
exercises.explanation: Indian elephants have got SMALL ears. Big ears are for African elephants! 🐘

exercises.question: The Indian rhino has got one horn.
exercises.explanation: Yes! The Indian rhino has got one horn. African rhinos have two! 🦏

exercises.question: The Bengal tiger hides in tall ___ . 🌿
exercises.explanation: The Bengal tiger hides in tall grass to hunt deer! 🐯🌿

grammar.title: Present Simple — тренировка
grammar.rule:
📘 **Ещё раз правила**:

✅ I/You/We/They + глагол (без -s)
✅ He/She/It + глагол + -s

🎯 **Примеры**:
✅ Tigers eat meat. (множественное число — без -s)
✅ A tiger eats meat. (одно животное — с -s)
✅ Elephants live in India.
✅ An elephant lives in India.

exercises.question: Tigers ___ (hunt) deer in the jungle. 🐯
exercises.explanation: Tigers — множественное число (they), поэтому hunt без -s! 🐯

exercises.question: A cobra ___ (live) in India. 🐍
exercises.explanation: A cobra — he/she/it (одна змея), поэтому lives с -s! 🐍

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct? 🐘
exercises.explanation: An elephant — one animal (he/she/it) → eats с -s! 🐘

exercises.question: Snakes lives in grass.
exercises.explanation: Snakes — множественное число (they), поэтому live без -s! 🐍

exercises.question: An Indian rhino ___ (like) to sit in water. 🦏
exercises.explanation: A rhino — one animal (he/she/it) → likes с -s! 🦏💧

days.title: Day 6: Writing — My Favourite Animal
days.description: Пишем текст о любимом животном по плану

grammar.title: Повторение: описание животного
grammar.rule:
📚 **План для письма**:

1️⃣ What is it? (Название животного)
2️⃣ Where does it live? (Где живёт?)
3️⃣ What does it look like? (Как выглядит?)
4️⃣ What does it eat? (Что ест?)
5️⃣ Why do you like it? (Почему ты его любишь?)

🎯 **Пример**:
My favourite animal is the Bengal tiger. It lives in India. It has got orange fur with stripes. It eats deer. I like it because it is beautiful and strong!

exercises.question: My favourite animal is the ___ . (напиши название)
exercises.explanation: Напиши название своего любимого животного! 🐯

exercises.question: It ___ in India. (live / lives)
exercises.explanation: It — he/she/it → lives с -s! 🌍

exercises.question: It has got ___ fur with stripes. (orange / black)
exercises.explanation: Напиши цвет своего животного! 🎨

exercises.question: It ___ deer. (eat / eats)
exercises.explanation: It — he/she/it → eats с -s! 🍖

exercises.question: I like it because it is ___ and ___ . (напиши два прилагательных)
exercises.explanation: Напиши два слова, почему тебе нравится это животное! Например: beautiful, strong 💪
